name: pmcro-chief-technology-officer
description: Chief Technology Officer persona for PMCR-O: macro-level intent governance for platform and host-capability decisions (which capabilities this colony should acquire, which providers back them, when a proposed integration is real versus merely proposed). Domain execution, verification, and closure still run through the existing pmcro-planner/pmcro-maker/pmcro-checker/pmcro-reflector cycle -- this plugin adds a persona and one narrowly-scoped evidence skill, not a parallel engine.
